 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as “ Zameen Aurum ”, comprising of inter alia community shops and residential apartments, located at Plot No. 15-A, Block L, Gulberg III, Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer is desirous to purchase the community shop / Residential Apartment as described in Description of Unit (“ Unit ”); and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell the Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer will sell the rights in the Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 Description of Unit ; 
 This Agreement to Sell ; 
 General Terms and Conditions ; 
 Nominees Form; 
 Attachment A: Payment Plan ; 
 Attachment B: Unit Floor Plan ; 
 A ttachment C: List of Material s ; and 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read , understood and agrees to comply with th e Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Amenities means any additional amenities that may be made available to the Buyer or occupant of the Other Unit s by the Developer, after the handover of possession of Unit, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations under Clause 4 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Area and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Units and do not form part of any given Unit. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority including, inter alia, the Lahore Development Authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated Completion Date 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause 4 (Construction and Possession of Unit) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project. 
 
 Developer means Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited with its office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M . M . Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment , including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan , is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 13.1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Furnishing s means the furniture items listed in Table C of Attachment C . 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining , operati ng or mana ging the Project or any part thereof, including , inter alia , the Parking Area, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means such person, as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer , under the Agreement to Sell , to Buyer’s legal heirs , in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Area means the demarcated parking area for the exclusive use of the Buyer, visitors and occupants of a specified Unit situated in the Project, the exact position whereof is to be allocated on or before the Completion Date. 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Attachment A of the Agreement to Sell, setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer. 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Unit as per the Unit type specified in the Description of the Unit, strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below). 
 
 Project means the real estate project, named and styled as ‘ Zameen Aurum’ , being constructed and developed by the Developer at Plot No. 15-A, Block L, Gulberg III, Lahore . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Unit (exclusive of tax) including Component Material s , White Goods (as specified in A ttachment C ) , in the manner and in such instalments as identified in the Payment Plan in Attachment A to the Agreement to Sell , as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause 10.2 and any Adjusted Amount in terms of Clause 3.3 of the Agreement . 
 
 Unit means the residential apartment or community shop, as shown in the Unit Floor Plan, including White Goods, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement . 
 
 Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Unit and its location, as shown in Attachment B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s / Occupant’s rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the all Unit s . 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance at the time of possession of the Unit and in accordance with the Clause 3.1(ii) of the General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges means the amount payable periodically by the Buyer to the Management Company, pursuant to the management agreement to be executed between the Parties , as a service charges fee for management, administration, maintenance and control of the Project, without limitation the Unit, Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Area . The amount of Service Charge shall be determined by the Management Company in its absolute discretion . 
 
 
 Other Unit (s) means any one or more of residential apartment, community shop, penthouse or other type of unit in the Project, other than the Unit.

 SALE OF UNIT 
 
 The Developer agrees to sell the Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Unit from the Developer, with the Purchase Price as the sale consideration, strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement . 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 The sale and transfer of the Unit by the Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date , as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Attachment A of the Agreement , along with any applicable Adjusted Amount; 
 
 Payment of one-time Service Charges Advance by the Buyer at the time of possession of the Unit, unless otherwise specified, to be determined as per fair market rates; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection charges, as per applicable laws, as and when due; 
 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable taxes, fees, stamp duties, levies (if any) related to the Unit as per Clause 5 below; and 
 
 In the event that the Buyer chooses to have his/her rights in the Unit recorded in the relevant department / revenue record , then completion of any and all formalities in relation thereto shall be solely fulfilled by the Buyer . 
 
 T he Purchase Price does not include any costs associated with the transfer and recording of any rights in the Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale/purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) as envisaged under Clause 3.1(iv) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Unit shall remain fixed under the Agreement except in the event of any unforeseeable events arising that are not in control of the Developer ( hereinafter “ Unforeseeable Event ”) including but not limited to : (i) any increase in the prevailing market rates of White Goods and Component Material s including but not limited to those specified in A ttachment C appended to this Agreement; (ii) any change in the rates of the Component Material s , as notified by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, State Bank of Pakistan, vide the price indices (including, without limitation, as a result of fluctuation in the FOREX rates); (iii) any increase in the bill of quantities; (iv) any change in the Project design and layouts, and/or (v) any change in the applicable taxes or levy of any additional tax with respect to White Goods and Component Material s . Any change in the Purchase Price due to an Unforeseeable Event shall be referred to as the “ Adjusted Amount ”. The Adjusted Amount shall be calculated and adjusted in the Purchase Price from time to time, in such manner and at such time as communicated by the Developer. The Developer shall make reasonable effort that the Purchase Price remains unaffected and ensure that any adjustments to the Purchase Price are fair and reasonable . 
 
 The adjustment in the Purchase Price under Clause 3.3 shall only be to the extent of increase in the price of Component Materials , White Goods and applicable t axes, and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount on or before the time of handing over of possession of the Unit to the Buyer . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/or Adjusted Amount on its Due Date, without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges, conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise, all of which shall be borne by the Buyer. The Instalment Payment / A djusted A mount shall be paid by one of the following means in the Developer’s account on or before the relevant Due Date, and the Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of the Agreement, entitling the Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 12.1. 
 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “ Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited” ;

 T he Buyer has made the Down Payment. The effectiveness of this Agreement is conditional upon the realization of funds in the Developer’s designated account. In case the funds are not realised within five (5) days of the signing of the Agreement to Sell , then this Agreement shall stand terminated . 
 
 In addition to other obligations of t he Buyer to make payments, the Buyer shall also pay Service Charges to the Management Company. In the event that utilities are provided to the Buyer directly by the Management Company, such amounts will be in addition to the Services Charges or Services Charges Advance and the Buyer shall settle any such charges as per consumption or usage promptly when required to do so . 
 
 CONSTRUCTION AND POSSESSION OF UNIT 
 
 It is agreed and understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date represents the date by which it is presently expected that the Project will be completed, and the Unit will be ready for handover to the Buyer . W hereas the Completion Date represents the actual date by which the Project is completed and the Unit is ready for handover to the Buyer. 
 
 The Developer shall issue the Completion Notice to the Buyer communicating the Completion Date and informing the Buyer to make all outstanding payments, under the Agreement, in order for the possession of the Unit to be delivered to the Buyer . The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date, in which case the Developer shall give one (1) month’s advance notice to the Buyer. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to (but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. The Instalment Payment and Adjusted Amount due on possession, as indicated in the Payment Plan, shall, under this Clause 4.2, only be payable by the Buyer at the time of possession. Transfer of possession shall be subject to the Buyer having fully performed his/her obligations under the Agreement and clearing all required payment(s), charges and taxes under provisions of the Agreement, including the Buyer having completed all applicable transfer formalities, including payment of all fees, charges and stamp duty etc., and, where applicable, recording of the Buyers rights in the Unit with any relevant Competent Authority. 
 
 On the Completion Date, subject to terms of this Agreement , the Developer shall transfer vacant possession of the Unit to the Buyer and issue the allotment letter in favour of the Buyer. The Developer shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer, including issuance of NOC for recording of Buyer’s rights in the Unit in the relevant department / revenue record , if requested by the Buyer . The Developer shall not be obliged to hand over possession of the Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under the Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of the Buyer’s rights in the relevant department / revenue record shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. 
 
 I f any Furnishings are offered by the Developer in Table C of Attachment C, then the same will be provided on the basis of the following terms. Provided that if no Furnishings are mentioned, Clause 4.4 and 4. 5 are null and void. 
 
 Developer will provide the Buyer with a number of options for each item (colour, size, style) and the Buyer must make the selection within seven (7) calendar days thereof. In the event no option is selected within the stipulated time, the Developer shall have the right to revoke the offer of Furnishings and may provide a refund , at the discretion of the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that the options presented shall only be from the list of approved vendors of the Developer , and final vendor selection shall remain at the sole discretion of the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that the tentative price of the Furnishings given in Table C of Attachment C is the price of the items as on the date of execution of the Agreement. Accordingly, the Buyer undertakes that, i n the event that the market/actual price of any Furnishings is higher than the tentative price listed in Table C of Attachment C at the time of selection, the Buyer shall be liable to pay the difference to the Developer immediately. The Buyer further acknowledges that provision of Furnishings is dependent on the Buyer paying the difference, hence f ailure to do so will mean that the Furnishings cannot be provided . In this event, the Developer shall have the right to revoke the offer of Furnishings and provide a refund , at the Developer’s discretion . 
 
 The Buyer understands and acknowledges that no modification, alteration, or substitution shall be permitted after the selection has been finalized and communicated. In the event that the Buyer is not satisfied with any of the Furnishing options available and chooses not to avail any one or more of the items, the cost of the remaining items may be refunded by the Developer , at the Developer’s discretion . 
 
 
 T he Developer is committed to mak e every reasonable effort to provide the Buyer with Furnishings, however there might be instances where this cannot be achieved. In such circumstances , the Developer , at its sole discretion, reserves the right to withdraw the offer of Furnishings specified in Table C of Attachment C (if any) and process a refund in favour of the Buyer. 
 
 Any refund under Clause 4.4 (if any) , as may be given at the discretion of the Developer, will be subject to the following: 
 
 The Developer may , at its sole discretion, adjust or set - off a refund under Clause 4.4 against any outstanding payments due from the Buyer to the Developer under this Agreement. 
 
 A refund (if any) shall always mean a refund of the tentative price of a corresponding item of Furnishing mentioned in Table C of Attachment C , and shall not under any circumstances , exceed the amount indicated in Table C of Attachment C. 
 
 
 The Developer shall , to the extent possible, obtain and assign to the Buyer the benefit of any manufacturers’ warranties, in respect of any White Goods and Furnishing provided in the Unit under this Agreement . The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty in this regard, including with respect to the fitness for use or quality of any White Goods or Furnishings and has relied on the manufacturers'/suppliers' representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all White Goods in the Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of the same, and the Developer shall have no liability thereof including but not limited to any extension in the warranty periods. 
 
 In the event, the Buyer fails to take over possession of the Unit on the Completion Date, for any reason whatsoever, then a ll risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Unit shall be transferred with actual possession. In addition , the Buyer shall be obligated to pay a monthly fee for each month he fails to take possession. 
 
 The Buyer shall pay, as and when due and without delay, all costs and charges for electricity, water and meter installation and connections charges, and failure to do so will be a default under this Agreement. The Developer shall facilitate the Buyer to obtain permanent electricity, water and meter connections for the Unit on or before the Completion Date, subject to the Buyer having fulfilled all of his/her obligations hereunder. 
 
 Subject to Clause 4.2 above, the Buyer shall take actual possession of the Unit within thirty (30) days of the Completion Date. In the event the Buyer fails to make the relevant payments as required under Clause 3.1 or otherwise to take possession of the Unit within said thirty (30) days of the Completion Date, the Buyer shall , inter alia , be responsible for such additional charge(s) as the Developer deems fit to cover its administration and service costs in order to manage and maintain the Unit. Furthermore , the Buyer shall be liable for all risk and costs applicable to the Unit as and from the Completion Date (including loss of or damage to the Unit or any part thereof). 
 
 TAXES 
 
 The Buyer shall be solely responsible for all t axes, duties, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities and other charges with respect to the Unit. To the extent any payment of any such taxes, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities or other charges are paid by the Developer , in the Developer’s absolute discretion, on behalf of the Buyer the same shall be reimbursed by the Buyer as and when demanded by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer agrees to pay all taxes and assessments in respect of the Unit from the Completion Date. 
 
 TRANSFER AND RESALE OF UNIT 
 
 In the event that after transfer and possession of the Unit in favour of the Buyer, the Buyer intends to sell the Unit to any other person (“ Third Party ”), in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the sale of the Unit to such Third Party shall not be permitted unless an NOC for sale is obtained by the Buyer from the Developer in advance , upon obtaining which the title of the Unit may be transferred from the Buyer to the Third Party in the relevant department / revenue record land registry (if required), costs whereof will be in addition to any applicable transfer charges. The Buyer undertakes that such Third Party shall be bound by the terms and conditions of the Agreement, as and when applicable, and the Buyer shall ensure that such Third Party does and executes all such acts, deeds and things as required under the Agreement. 
 
 In the event that prior to transfer and possession of the Unit in favour of the Buyer, the Buyer intends to transfer her/his rights with respect to the Unit to any Third Party , in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the transfer of such rights in the Unit to such Third Party shall not be permitted unless an NOC for transfer is obtained by the Buyer from the Developer in advance , costs whereof will be in addition to any applicable transfer charges. The Buyer undertakes that such Third Party shall be bound by the terms and conditions of the Agreement, as and when applicable, and the Buyer shall ensure that such Third Party does and executes all such acts, deeds and things as required under the Agreement . 
 
 The Buyer will execute all documents and obtain all permissions, NOCs and/or approvals as may be required by the Developer from time to time. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only the title of the Unit shall be transferred to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no title, right or interest in the Project other than the limited rights of access to Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Area as expressly provided herein. For the avoidance of doubt, Buyer needs the approval of the building management to make internal structural changes in the Unit. The Buyer further understands and acknowledges that the ownership rights to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Area, roof and exterior walls shall always rest with the Developer, and the Buyer shall not be permitted to affect any change in the colour scheme, design of external walls, and/or layout in relation thereto, including any projections, hooks or nails, etc. 
 
 The Developer shall endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Unit as per the specifications in the Description of Unit. However, in the event of any modification, the Developer may substitute the Unit with another unit with similar specifications as the Unit. In the event the substitute Unit provided to the Buyer is of a materially lesser value, the Buyer will be entitled to a refund of the difference between the Purchase Price of the original Unit and the substitute Unit without any mark up or adjustment thereon, subject to the terms of the Agreement. 
 
 
 PARKING SPACE 
 
 The Developer will allocate the Parking Area(s) with respect to the Unit on the Completion Date. The Buyer confirms that any right to use the Parking Area assigned to the Unit will be in a form of a special permission and is linked to the ownership /occupancy of the Unit . T he Buyer will have no right to transfer or sub-let or otherwise dispose of with the Parking Area. Additional parking spaces can be made available to the Buyer subject to (i) availability, and (ii) payment of the requisite fee, as may be prescribed by the Developer or the Management Company from time to time. The Buyer further confirms that the Developer may at any time at its sole discretion take back any additional parking spaces allocated to the Buyer. Such additional parking spaces shall be held on the same terms and conditions as the Parking Area. 
 
 BUYER’S COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer covenants, represents, undertakes or warrants as under: 
 
 T he Buyer has the necessary legal capacity and authority to purchase the Unit ; and 
 
 T he Unit will be used only for the Permitted Use. 
 
 The Buyer warrants that the Buyer shall and shall procure that any Third Party shall: 
 
 act strictly in complete compliance with this Agreement and the Rules including, inter alia , any policy with respect to resale and transfer of the Unit and all other rules and regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable on the Unit, and to make all payments of duties, taxes, levies and charges whatsoever as may be applicable on the Unit or the Buyer’s ownership thereof or other rights therein . 
 
 not lease, assign, mortgage, encumber or hypothecate any interest in the Unit without the prior written approval of the Developer and/or Management Company (which may be withheld or conditioned at its sole discretion). For the avoidance of doubt, any disposition of interest in terms of this sub-clause 8.3(ii) without the prior written approval of the Developer and/or Management Company shall be void and shall constitute a material breach of contract; 
 
 execute a contract with the Management Company for payment of Service Charges to the Management Company, determined as per fair market rates, relating to the use and upkeep of the Common Areas, Common Facilities and/or Parking Area; 
 
 permit the Management Company, and its employees, representatives and agents at all reasonable times to enter the Unit to carry out its duties; 
 
 not do anything in the Unit or Project which may be or become a security hazard, nuisance, annoyance, disturbance, inconvenience or cause damage to the Common Area and Common Facilities or to the other people occupying/using any Other Units in the Project and will ensure that the Unit, the Common Areas and Common Facilities are kept clean; 
 
 not use the Unit for any illegal, unlawful or immoral act or purpose and shall not store inflammable or hazardous material or any material forbidden by law in the Unit; 
 
 comply in all respects with the provisions of all laws, decrees, regulations and the Rules including the rules of and requirements of any Competent Authority in relation to the Unit or anything done in the Unit; 
 
 pay all charges (including meter connection charges relating to the Unit) for water, electricity, sewage, telephone/cables and other services provided to the Unit, maintenance fees and other similar levies that may be imposed or levied with respect to the Unit from the Completion Date; 
 
 not make any partitions, alterations, additions, attachments of any nature whatsoever in the Unit, Common Areas or Facilities or to the Project without the Developer’s and/or the Management Company’s written consent in advance, and that the Buyer will pay such administration charges to the Developer / Management Company as may be demanded for vetting plans in respect of such partitions, alterations, attachments or additions; 
 
 understands and acknowledges that the Buyer’s obligations under the Agreement shall continue beyond the Completion Date; 
 
 undertakes to maintain insurance over the Unit as may be prescribed in the Rules; 
 
 ensure s and undertake s that no graffiti, signboard, advertisement, logo is made or posted or attached on the outside/exterior walls of the Unit; 
 
 not keep or store in the Unit or in the Common Areas, articles of heavy load or size which may damage the Unit or create nuisance of any kind for other occupants; 
 
 not place or store any equipment or goods , of any kind whatsoever, in the balconies and the terraces or window displays of the Unit which is not in accordance with the Rules, or which may damage the same or adversely affect the fa ç ade of the Unit or Project or may endanger any other occupants or utilize the same in any manner which has been restricted by the Developer or the Management Company; 
 
 not alter the aesthetic view of the Unit or the Project . The Buyer shall maintain , at all times, the structure of the Unit in such a state of repair and condition which provide structural support, protection and design to the Project, and not harm or damage the Project in any manner; an d 
 
 not use the Unit or Project or any part thereof for any commercial activity of any kind at any time other than in accordance with the Permitted Use. In case of breach, the Developer or the Management Company may take such actions in terms of the Rules or reasonable legal action to prevent or halt such activity or take any other action in accordance with the Rules and applicable laws. 
 
 The Buyer shall be liable for any damage caused to the structure, material, fittings and fixtures including , inter alia , mechanical, plumbing and electrical works, where the damage is caused by normal wear and tear, an Event of Force Majeure or where there is breakage or accidental damage caused or contributed to by any act or omission of the Buyer, occupant or visitor of the Unit. 
 
 The Buyer shall pay Service Charges to the Management Company in a timely manner, which shall be payable even if the Unit is lying vacant. All other regulations imposed by the Management Company or any association of owners or a Competent Authority in the present and in future will form a part of the Agreement. In addition to the Service Charges, it is understood by the Buyer that various Common Facilities and Common Areas, including , inter alia , elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, may require major repair or replacement, which shall be charged on pro-rata basis to all the occupants of the Projects, including the Buyer. The Buyer shall be required to pa y the aforesaid amounts within the time stipulated by the Management Company. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands and accepts that the Developer shall have the sole authority and discretion to frame the Rules. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that the Developer shall construct the infrastructure relating to the Project including boundary walls, roads, lighting, walkways, lobbies, hallways and landscaping substantively in accordance with the Developer’s overall development plan for infrastructure and the Buyer shall have no objection to it. 
 
 The Buyer agrees not to modify, add or remove any part of the exterior and/or interior of the Unit or construct any additional improvements in the Unit without the prior written consent of the Developer. 
 
 Buyer hereby represents and warrants that the Buyer shall not mortgage or create any other kind of lien, charge, encumbrance, etc on Unit without the prior written consent from the Developer or the Management Company. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and declares that all the statements made and information provided by the Buyer in the Agreement are true and correct. 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT BY THE BUYER 
 
 No sale, assignment, transfer , lease or other disposition of any interest in the Unit (hereinafter referred to as the “Transfer” for the purpose of this Clause 9) , whether before or after the Completion Date, by the Buyer will be binding on the Developer or of any legal effect until and unless: 
 
 the Developer’s prior written consent in respect of the Transfer has been obtained by the Buyer; 
 
 the fees payable under Clause 9.2 or otherwise howsoever have been paid in full to the satisfaction of the Developer /Management Company ; 
 
 all relevant T axes, duties, and charges (including stamp duties and registration charges) have been paid in respect of the T ransfer by the Buyer ; 
 
 all payments due as at the effective date of the proposed transfer, including any Service Charges, have been paid in full to the Developer, Management Company and any Competent Authorities to their satisfaction; and 
 
 the transferee to the Unit has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by the Agreement, the agreement with the Management Company, and has signed a letter of adherence (or such other document) in relation thereto as may be prescribed by the Developer and/or the Management Company in this regard. 
 
 The Transfer of the Unit by the Buyer shall be subject to payment of transfer charges of one percent (1%) of the Purchase Price of the Unit, and any other applicable fees at the time, to the Developer /Management Company . While allowing the Transfer , the Developer /Management Company shall have the right to impose additional terms and conditions. 
 
 The Developer may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under the Agreement or with respect to the Project to any person or party , without giving any notice to the Buyer , and the Buyer hereby consents to any such assignment or transfer. 
 
 MODIFICATIONS TO THE UNIT 
 
 The Developer will endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Project and Unit as per this Agreement. However, the construction of the Project and the Unit may be affected according to the plans/specifications approved by the Competent Authorities. Similar quality will be provided for any substituted items pertaining to the Unit Floor Plan, colours, materials, finishes, equipment, fixtures and specifications of the Unit. The Buyer shall be consulted in the event that any material change varies by more than ten percent (10%). 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that for the purposes of the Agreement, the total area is measured from the exterior face of the exterior wall, middle of the unit demising walls and exterior face of the corridor walls and includes all balconies and terraces. If the actual total area as determined by the Developer ’ s engineer is more or less than the represented total area by more than two percent (2%), the Purchase Price will be adjusted by an amount equal to the variance above two percent (2%). For the avoidance of doubt, no adjustment will be made to the Purchase Price if the total area is increased or is reduced by less than two percent (2%). Provided that any change or alteration in the size and structure of the Project shall not exceed more than ten percent (10%). 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that the area and specifications of the Unit, as shown in the Unit Floor Plan and the D escription of Unit is an approximation only and acknowledges that the actual floor area may vary from the area as stated in the Unit Floor Plan . 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE DEVELOPER 
 
 11.1 I n the event that the Developer is unable to deliver possession of the Unit within eighteen ( 18 ) months following the Estimated Completion Date, then the Buyer may terminate the Agreement in accordance with the provisions hereof . In the event of termination by the Buyer a fter the lapse of eighteen ( 18 ) months , the Developer shall pay to the Buyer a sum of PKR 1000 per day for a maximum period of ninety (90) days. 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE BUYER AND DEFAULTING PENALTY 
 
 I f the Buyer fails to pay any Instalment Payment or other payments due under the Agreement to the Developer, the Management Company or to any Competent Authority, within thirty ( 30 ) days of its Due Date, then the Developer may impose liquidated damages at the rate of two percent (2%) per month from the Due Date on each outstanding Instalment Payment or any part thereof and/or any other payment(s) that remain(s) outstanding . Delay in payment of any payment due under the Agreement by the Buyer exceeding sixty (60) days from the relevant Due Date shall be treated as a material default by the Buyer and the Developer will be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 22 below . 
 
 Joint Buyers shall, jointly and individually, be responsible to fulfil and discharge all the obligations hereinabove mentioned. Upon breach of any of the conditions of the Agreement by any one or all of them, the Developer may resort to any legal means, in terms of the breach, against any one or all of the joint Buyers (as the Developer may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means an act of God including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm or other natural disaster; act of any sovereign authority including but not limited to war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, pandemics, epidemics, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, nationalization, requisition, act of terrorism or destruction or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority or other Competent Authority or imposition of government sanction embargo or similar action; labour dispute including but not limited to strike, lockout or boycott; interruption or failure of utility service including but not limited to electric power, water or telephone service; failure of the transportation of any personnel, equipment, machinery or material required by the Developer for completion of the Project; breach of contract by any essential contractor or subcontractor or any other matter or cause beyond the control of the Developer that prevents it from completing or performing its obligations under the Agreement. The Developer shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under the Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Estimate d Completion Date or Completion Date, the Developer shall promptly notify the Buyer in writing of the event and give the Buyer a revised Estimated Completion Date or Completion Date, as and when it can be determined. Extensions in the Estimated Completion Date or Completion Date on account of an Event of Force Majeure shall be in addition to any other extensions pursuant to the terms hereof. 
 
 No Event of Force Majeure which is less than thirty (30) calendar days shall excuse the Buyer from making any Instalment Payment on its Due Date. A ny Event of Force Majeure exceeding thirty (30) days shall result in a commensurate adjustment of the Due Date of any remaining Instalment Payments or any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Agreement, as defined in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and there are no other representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by the Developer, any officer, agent, employee or representative of the Developer or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, show room displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Buyer or made available for his/her viewing and, upon acceptance by the Developer, the Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject only to the terms and conditions contained therein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in the Agreement, any modification or amendment to the Agreement shall be in writing duly signed by both Parties. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that he/ she will be bound by the Management Agreement and any building rules, regulations and policies that may be applicable from time to time. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 
 The Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to the Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan and subject to clause 15.2, the Courts at Lahore shall have exclusive jurisdiction . 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act , 1940 . After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one each to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under the Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail, to the address of the Party to be served that is set out in the Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in the case there is more than one Buyer, notice to any one Buyer shall be deemed as notice to all Buyers and the Developer shall be under no obligation to write to each Buyer individually. 
 
 Buyer shall notify the Developer in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Buyer’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Developer to the Buyer at the last known address. 
 
 SURVIVAL 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that the Agreement will survive the Completion Date and transfer of the Unit in the name of the Buyer and any subsequent buyer. The Agreement shall en s ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assigns. 
 
 The Developer agrees that in case of the death of the Buyer, the Developer shall make reasonable efforts to assist the Nominee named by the Buyer to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Buyer under the Agreement, in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws of inheritance. Provided that the Nominee shall cause all such legal heirs to execute a letter of adherence (or such other document which confirms the legal heirs taking over and being fully bound by the obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement) and indemnify the Developer for any loss or damage on account of claims by the other legal heirs of the Buyer. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 The Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement. 
 
 TIME IS OF ESSENCE 
 
 With respect to the payments to be made by the Buyer, t ime shall be of essence under this Agreement, except to the extent of any cure periods or periods of delay envisaged in Clause 12 and 22 under this Agreement . 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of the Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 If any one or more provisions of the Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 TERMINATION AND CANCELLATION OF SALE 
 
 In the event that the Buyer has failed to fulfil its payment obligation s under Clause 12 of the Agreement (including payment of l iquidated damages) , the Developer may terminate this Agreement by serving a written notice of default to the Buyer for not less than seven (7) days. The Buyer shall be under an obligation to remedy the default within the time stipulated in the notice of default . However, if the default persists and is not cured by the Buyer within the time stipulated, the Developer may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect. Upon termination all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded, subject to such deductions as specified under Clause 22.4. For the avoidance of doubt, such deductions shall be in addition to the damages imposed under Clause 12.1 above. 
 
 Su b ject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Developer may at any time terminate the Agreement in the event that any statement, representation, warranty or information provided by the Buyer to the Developer under this Agreement is found to be incorrect or false by serving a notice in writing to the Buyer. Upon termination all Instalment Payments paid by the Buyer shall be refunded, subject to such deduction s as specified under Clause 22.4 . 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Buyer may terminate the Agreement at any time, by serving a notice in writing to the Developer. 
 
 Upon ter mination of the Agreement for any reason whatsoever : 
 
 any refund payable by the Developer to the Buyer, if any, shall be subject to deduction of cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price and deduction on account of any other cha r ge or cost payable by the Buyer under the Agreement ; 
 
 After deducting all charges under the Agreement, including any liquidated damages, from the Instalments Payments already paid by the Buyer, the Developer shall refund the balance amount, if any, to the Buyer . For the avoidance of doubt, i n the event of any shortfall, the Developer shall be entitled to recover the said amount from the Buyer; 
 
 any refund payable by the Developer to the Buyer, if any, will be refunded to the Buyer within six (6) months of termination or upon re-sale of the cancelled Unit, whichever comes later; 
 
 any refund shall be subject to deduction of the difference between the Purchase Price and the market price of the Unit at the time of termination, in the event that the latter is lower , as determined by the Developer in its absolute discretion ; and 
 
 the Buyer shall surrender all original documents, acknowledgements of receipt and any other correspondence under the Agreement, including without limitation the Agreement itself. 
 
 The Parties hereby agree and acknowledge that the liquidated damages stated in the Agreement do not constitute a penalty and are a genuine pre-estimate of the losses suffered by the Developer. 
 
 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
 
 Any liability of the Developer arising under or in relation to this Agreement, whether arising under contractual laws, tort or otherwise, shall under no circumstances whatsoever, exceed five per cent (5%) of the total payment(s) received by the Developer from the Buyer. 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under the Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 
 The Buyer hereby confirms having read, understood and accepted the Agreement in its entirety, and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
